description.value: W Breakfast & Lunch (marketed on its own website as W Restaurant) is a sit-down restaurant in downtown Fort St. John serving western-style breakfast and lunch fare — from fluffy pancakes and eggs benedicts to hearty hash, burgers, and sandwiches — crafted with an emphasis on fresh ingredients. The restaurant operates seven days a week and offers online ordering through Square for takeout convenience. Fort St. John sits along the Alaska Highway corridor, making it a natural resupply point for long-distance touring cyclists heading north.
